transcript: I love theater and sweet treats, so obviously I have to go to Schmackary's to try out the new Theater Lovers cookie. The Theater Lovers cookie is one of the exclusive Valentine's Day cookies at Schmackary's right now until February 15th. This is a strawberry cookie with a white chocolate chip and a strawberry glaze, and it is gluten free and freaking delicious. I paired mine with a hot apple cider and it was perfection.
classificationReason: Content is about a themed Valentine's Day cookie at Schmackary's bakery; not about any stage production.
